title: ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant
features: Introduced ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant for quick contextual answers and guided player navigation.
Added 22 curated question-and-answer topics covering character research, talents, gear, progression, account sessions, backups and more.
Provided suggested-question generation, topic filters, direct studio links and safe fallback messages when information is not documented.
Assistant operates locally from the static answer library without a generative AI connection, new Blizzard calls or account data access.
Updated Gateway, PC and mobile guides, Developer Test Requests, device QA and release history while preserving existing Warcraft features.
discord_message:
NEXUS | AZEROTH COMPANION v7.9.7 — ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant

NEW: A dedicated guided assistant for quick answers about Talent Forge, gear, Battle.net accounts, Blizzard API research, Mythic+, raids, reputations, addons and backups.

Includes rotating suggested questions, topic filters, reliable documented answers and direct studio shortcuts. This is a curated assistant, not a live generative AI model; it doesn't send questions or account tokens to a third-party AI service.

Updated PC/mobile guides, Developer Test Requests, compatibility checks and release information.

Preview pending full player acceptance testing.

https://zevromxr-hub.github.io/nexus-application-gateway/azeroth-companion/
Powered by ZevRo Development | NEXUS
acceptance_gates: Real browser tests for assistant question suggestions and matching answers
Check all 22 answer links and supported knowledge boundaries
Validate no account tokens, local saved data or typed questions transmitted
Carry forward Mythic+, raid, reputation and OAuth regression testing
publish_rule: Do not announce while staging. After verification promote to stable, update releases/index.json, and create official releases/v7.9.7.json in the watched trigger directory.
